meta.comment: engine.tax (MOD-052) / FEAT-056 (ASM-283): the UK-today tax-instrument set Aaron named — VAT, import duties, corporation tax, PAYE (income tax + NI), council tax, business rates. This file is the sole data source for these six instruments' names, categories, valid rate ranges, elasticity coefficients, bearer-split weights and zone-scoped overrides (GR#15: no instrument figure lives as a Go literal in internal/engine/tax/*.go). 'Blue 2'-style mechanic, cited for mechanic shape only, no literal feature parity — see mechanicReferenceNote.
meta.mechanicReferenceNote: 'Blue 2'-style mechanic, per docs/planning/resources-design-brief.md's established GR#22-clean citation form: the pairing of a tax instrument with a zone-differentiated rate lever as a single player-facing control (zoneOverrides per instrument). Cited for mechanic shape only — this file does not attempt literal feature parity with any external game.
meta.complexityCeiling: FEAT-056's explicit complexity ceiling: six instruments, one zoneOverrides shape (a map from a closed 8-class enum to a per-zone rate multiplier or relief), and no per-typology/per-behavioural-levy explosion beyond what engine.tax.md's already-committed scope governs. A future editor extending this file checks against this boundary, not against 'however much the last person added'.
meta.zoneClassEnum: The closed 8-way zone-class key set (M0 §34): dwelling, shop, office, entertainment, farming, manufacturing, heavyIndustry, mining — the only valid keys in any instrument's zoneOverrides map. No instrument may use a different spelling, casing, or ad-hoc subset.
meta.specRefs: §39 (fine-grain tax controls), §54 (the fiscal circuit: income tax per wage band, sales tax/VAT share on local consumption, corporation tax share on firm profits, rates & council tax, duties & levies), §34 (the 8-way zone classes that key zoneOverrides).
meta.assumptions: ASM-283 (file location data/tax_instruments.json, lead-ruled ACCEPT), ASM-284 (placeholder-values regime, Aaron-confirmed CLOSED), ASM-287 (per-instrument bearer categories, lead-ruled ACCEPT), and this file's own ASM-415 (UK-today set extends §39's named panel), ASM-416 (zoneOverrides generalised to every instrument), ASM-417 (policy-side zone scoping flagged to Bill, not resolved here), ASM-418 (bearer-category sets for the four new instruments), ASM-423 ('Blue 2' resolved as mechanic-shape citation only).
meta.placeholderConvention: Every numeric field in every instrument (rate, threshold, elasticity coefficient, zone-override multiplier, bearer share) carries a sibling comment naming its source category — one of 'literature-grounded placeholder (UK published figure, mapping sanity-check only)', 'derived placeholder (no external anchor, sanity-check the number itself)', or 'spec-transcribed (rare)' — plus pending-Aaron's-balance-pass status, per data/market.json's 'Plausible v1 static price, pending M2 Batch tuning' convention and ASM-284. Monetary amounts are int64 micro-pounds (1 GBP = 1,000,000 micro-pounds, M0-ENG §1.2); percentage rates, elasticity coefficients and bearer shares are legitimately fractional.
